title: Do the Raiders have a true quarterback competition?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Do the Raiders have a true quarterback competition?
sources.description: Despite plenty of struggles since last winning the Super Bowl more than four years before Kirk Cousins was born, the Raiders have earned the first overall pick in the draft only twice: in 2007 and in 2026.
